COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
SA No. 133 of 2025
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Admittedly, the person of which a declaration 
was sought was missing since last 80 years and there is 
no such evidence that any attempt was made to find 
out though publication was made only after filing of 
the suit. 
4. There is concurrent finding of facts, however, 
before admitting the appeal, let the trial court record be 
summoned. 
5. Registry is directed to send the requisition for 
summoning the trial court record of Civil Suit No. 05 of 
2023 from the concerned trial court. 
6. List in the month of March, 2026.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 30.12.2025
SKS

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
08.05.2026 SA No.133 of 2025
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel for 
the appellant. 
2. Mr. I. P. Kohli, learned Standing Counsel for 
the State. 
3. Supplementary affidavit (IA No.1 of 2025) is 
taken on record. Misc. Application stands disposed 
of. 
4. Supplementary affidavit (IA No. 2 of 2025), 
filed by the appellant in pursuance of the directions 
of the Coordinate Bench of this Court, is taken on 
record. It is made clear that the supplementary 
affidavit shall be examined at a later stage. 
Accordingly, the miscellaneous application stands 
disposed of.
5. TCR has been received. 
6. Registry is directed to prepare the paper book 
and supply the same to the learned counsel for the 
parties on payment of usual charges.
7. List on 05.06.2026 for admission. 
(Siddhartha Sah, J.) 
 08.05.2026
